If you are discovering Amberial Dreams today, welcome, you are now a Dreamer! And a Roller, too.
You are about to enter a [b]cosmic precision platformer packed with rhythmic contraptions, arcade platforming and colourful worlds[/b]!
We hope you will love being with us, in our world filled with wonders and wicked levels.

[previewyoutube=AP4zdHkSgc8;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h2]WHAT'S AMBERIAL DREAMS YOU SAY?[/h2]

[h3]SIMPLE YET SKILLED[/h3]

Amberial Dreams is a simple yet challenging [b]precision platformer[/b] set in a dream-like evolving world. Roll left and right, using your momentum and terrain features to bounce through deadly traps, pixel perfect jumps or atmospheric levels. 
Explore the story at your own pace, compete on online leaderboards, or create and share your own levels!
Join us in rediscovering the Amberial hit series after four flash titles.

[h3]RESTORE THE BALANCE, ONE WORLD AT A TIME[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/491f6ba5a663dfbfaf84caeef58321651dc6c0fc.png[/img]
Throughout the campaign, you will [b]embody the avatar of Amber[/b], one of the Dreamers, shapers of this universe. 
The other Dreamers have disappeared leaving you [b]alone against a growing corruption[/b]. 
Witness the sinister changes that have occurred during your long slumber and find a way to [b]restore balance, one world at a time.[/b]
Roll through an even greater challenge in the Spire of Trials. [b]A collection of infamous and wicked levels[/b], putting even veterans to the test.

[h3]ONE OF THE BEST LEVEL EDITORS[/h3]

Amberial  Dreams  features  one  of  the  most  complete level editor tools in the platformer genre. [b]Everything is usable by the community[/b] up to the levels themselves.
[list]
[*]A powerful level editor allowing players to modify each campaign level or create their own.
[*]An advanced curation system to find the best levels quickly through  tags, endorsement and notes.
[*]Dozens of unique community levels already available, and many more to come.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/8435a573e1a1b9b0398983dc9cfe9680087f6f82.jpg[/img]
[b]LEVEL EDITOR TIPS & TRICKS[/b]
[list]
[*]Play with levels you already beat.
You can use the template of any level you have beaten. Explore the possibilities!
[*]Have fun with the physical properties!
A lot of elements have different properties, modifying how they work. You can always move them to the foreground or background to add extra spice![/list]
[h3]A GAME WE WANT TO BUILD WITH YOU[/h3]

Based on its four predecessors and the [b]feedbacks of two million players[/b], Amberial Dreams keeps the same dynamic. 
Throughout the Early Access, we will release [b]regular patches and major content updates[/b] with gameplay elements, levels, quality of life improvements as well as new tools for the community.
[b]We want the players to be part of what defines the game, and of the priorities of our updates[/b] thanks to their feedback and comments! Join our official Amberial Dreams Discord Server to ask questions, provide feedback, suggest new features and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h2]STARTING TIPS[/h2]
To get the ball rolling! (Yep, I just did that.)

[h3]CONTROL YOUR MOMENTUM[/h3]
On the ground or even mid-air, you can modify your speed and trajectory. The faster you will roll, the less accurate you will be, but the farther you will go.

[h3]USE THE TERRAIN TO YOUR ADVANTAGE[/h3]
Knowing how to use the terrain, elements and contraptions around to speed you up, slow you down or make you jump to your destination will make everything easier.

[h3]THINK OUTSIDE THE BOX[/h3]
The obvious way might not be the best one. Many levels offer shortcuts for those who dare!

[h3]TAKE A BREAK[/h3]
Harder levels can be frustrating at first, give it some time! Be kind to yourself, take a break, sip some tea or coffee and get back to it once you're ready to crack your knuckles and tackle the challenge at hand. 
Also, you don’t need to beat every level to progress through the campaign. You might learn some helpful tricks down the line!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/c467ad34e5091644bbc898fcf17544c71c919adc.png[/img]

[h2]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/h2]

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]How long is the Early Access going to last? When is the full release planned?[/b][/h3]

The Early Access is planned to last one year and the game should release Q4 2023.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]What is the price of the game in the Early Access? Will it become more expensive at launch?[/b][/h3]

The game is priced at 6.99$/€ in EA. It will become 9.99$/€ for the full launch.
However, right now and until October 24, the game will be at 15% off!
You can get it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/917140/Amberial_Dreams/

Whilst the game is fully playable, we want to use to use the community feedback to keep improving it and add content. It is paramount for us to  grow our world together with the players.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

[h3][b]What content can we expect from the game in and after its Early Access launch?[/b][/h3]

At the start of Early Access, the game will have 4 worlds and 50 levels. 
After the EA launch, more content will progressively be added into the game. 
You can expect overtime:

[/list]We'll also expand on the level creation and sharing system.

[h2]COME AND ROLL WITH US[/h2]
[i][b]we bouncy[/b][/i]

notes.title: The Editor Update is here!
notes.content:
Version [b]0.7.0[/b] is a bold step that believes in a bright and creative future for Amberial Dreams!

We have spent most of this update's effort updating core systems, adding features to the Atelier, and creating pieces that add new ways to think about levels. In this update, I want to thank [b]inakilbss[/b] for contributing so much to the systems and the math logic that I lack.

Without rambling any longer, here is the list!

[h1]Atelier (Level Builder)[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Multi-select! Grab multiple pieces and Move, Rotate, Delete, or Duplicate them together.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/7d00f96fd178861a0c2b0fd1591fab34016f6ea1.gif[/img]

[*] Corner Scaling and better selection gizmos! (by [b]inakilbss[/b])
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/ea0e336a0acdea40e6de070aed34a47894d2f971.gif[/img]

[*] Depth sorting, so you can choose which pieces to show in front of others (with 5 layers)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/a8962f3af7139271ce4b62fcca31a15fa26b60d4.png[/img]

[*] Ability to adjust width and height of levels towards a particular direction (anchor in the level properties panel)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/89fd282c305b5144656c128e6e1f2f344ce36f27.jpg[/img]

[*] Redo

[*] New dedicated Panning Tool, with included shortcuts (Spacebar or Middle Mouse) and new cursors[
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/9883379c97dcdf98b2b96a48041e39f7ffe2277f.png[/img] 

[*] Displaying Kill limits in the editor  (by [b]inakilbss[/b])
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/34828616a3a4789c15903c730e32c7fc343c3460.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/83c619faf93c4360f83c0ff540925cafa7b71891.png[/img][/url]

[*] The environment list in the editor now shows a small thumbnail
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes and small improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the scaling of non-sliced objects, specially with the grid turned on.  (by [b]inakilbss[/b])

[*] Scaling and panning now correctly takes into account the zoom level

[*] Fixed Environment not being pre-selected in the Level Properties Panel.

[*] Increased Zoom-out limits.

[*] Allow All pieces to be rotated fully

[*] Fixed Scaling gizmo overflow bug

[*] Better top menu responsiveness
[/list]

[h1]Pieces[/h1]
[list]
[*] Sparklebugs (flashing, rollable, interactable)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/c89e60a7975a14af3e17d115aaa664e5741fc97d.gif[/img]

[*] Grass Hills (they will change colour depending on the environment in a future update)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/e6d5daf1fcdffd9c4b965a976724264d99a7b448.png[/img]

[*] Simple Solid Rings
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/c4d4b4687cba0d136abd08841d587d50a6d6ee74.png[/img]

notes.title: Rolling into 2021
notes.content:
[b]Rolling into 2021[/b]

Now that the Community on Discord has been fairly active, I've felt like it's a bit redundant to post detailed update notes in here. So instead, I will use this space to talk about important decisions and how things are going at a higher level.

However, if you want to see and discuss the detail notes, you can see them in the discord channel here:
https://discord.gg/HnJ2qhZ

And view the general roadmap at:
https://trello.com/b/zHJZ8k2q/amberial-dreams

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/0f755ed675300b12dfdc5243e012dbc975fdc85f.png[/img]

[b]Community[/b]
Starting and Nurturing the Discord Server has been the best thing to happen to the Development of Amberial Dreams. 
Specially since the Steam Festival, there have always been conversations, prompt feedback for new versions, and lots of levels made by the players in there. But most importantly, getting to know you and witnessing a true interest in the game has been the biggest source of motivation I've received. So thank you everyone! From the fans of the original, to the speed runners, to the level makers :)

Also, I am very excited to announce that we will now be [b]formally[/b] working with 2 members of this community! [b]@markdarkness[/b] for the lore/story, and [b]@inakilbss[/b] for help with coding the more math-based portions of the game.

[b]Roadmap Summary[/b]
The general plan is now:
[olist]
[*] -Improve and add to the Level Editor Tools
[*] -Create Lots of new Contraptions and Story bits. Start bringing new Levels together
[*] -Improving Contraption graphics. Put together the new Worlds and Hub areas, start polishing the v1.0 level selection
[*] -Add remaining meta/hub features
[*] -All while continuing to fix bugs and improve the core mechanics.
[/olist]

With this plan, we are currently planning to Release version 1.0 publicly in  [b]August[/b]  -But noting of course that this may change down the line, as shipping something great is more important that shipping it early.

[b]Steam Festival and Demo[/b]
The Steam Festival was a success in terms of feedback and engagement. Thank you to everyone who played the demo, gave their opinion, and put the game on their wishlist!

The Demo will now be disabled, as it was only meant to receive feedback during the Steam Festival; but if someone sorely misses it, please come to the Discord to arrange special access.

Until next time,
-Cuauhtemoc "oddgoo" Moreno

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33475308/4d15b0626d4795b99d5f73877c05fcef320c8b01.png[/img]
